title: Grateful Dead Live at Grand Prix Racecourse on 1973-07-28

ai_review.summary: A historic July 1973 Watkins Glen show shines with a monster Mountain Jam, captured in a mixed soundboard‑audience matrix that is mostly clear but occasionally gritty.
ai_review.review: The performance is celebrated for its powerful Mountain Jam and tight setlist highlights like “Here Comes Sunshine” and the China Cat Sunflower → I Know You Rider sequence.  The recording blends soundboard and audience sources, delivering a generally listenable experience though it suffers from static in “Truckin’”, spliced audience cuts on “Row Jimmy” and occasional diginoise that may require EQ adjustments.

ai_rating.rationale: Average reviewer rating is ~4.3; most comments praise the show’s musical moments while noting only moderate recording flaws, leading to a strong positive overall assessment.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Mix of soundboard and audience tapes; generally clear but has distortion/static in “Truckin’”, low stage‑mic levels on several tracks, spliced audience cuts (e.g., Row Jimmy) and occasional diginoise that benefit from EQ tweaks.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows well, with a strong first half and an energetic second set; the historic collaboration with The Band and Allman Brothers adds extra excitement despite some source‑placement confusion around “Around & Around”.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for his adventurous guitar work on Mountain Jam, even ‘taking on Duane’ and delivering a compelling solo.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith's keyboard playing is highlighted as a strength; reviewers note the unusual presence of two keyboardists (Keith plus another organist) during “Around & Around”.
